title: Beyond Differences: Estimating and Tuning Ratio-Based Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2605.26288v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When treatment effects are naturally expressed as ratios -- as in medicine, pricing, and marketing -- the ratio-based CATE $\tau(x) = \mathbb{E}[Y|W=1,X=x] / \mathbb{E}[Y|W=0,X=x]$ is the appropriate estimand. Yet the common estimators divide by an estimated baseline, impose a parametric form, or regress the outcome, where a better fit need not mean a better effect estimate. We introduce the Q-Learner, which writes $\tau(x)$ as a ratio of two odds, reducing ratio-CATE estimation for binary outcomes to two propensity classification tasks. In benchmarks on synthetic and randomized real-world data, the Q-Learner proves especially suited to industry practice. translated_title: 超越差异：基于比率的处理效应估计与调优
translated_abstract: 当处理效应自然地表示为比率时——如医学、定价和营销等领域——基于比率的CATE τ(x) = E[Y|W=1,X=x] / E[Y|W=0,X=x] 是合适的目标量。然而常见的估计器要么除以估计的基线，要么施加参数形式，要么对结果进行回归建模，在这些情况下，更好的拟合并不一定意味着更好的效应估计。我们提出了Q-Learner，它将τ(x)表示为两个几率（odds）之比，从而将二元结果的比率CATE估计简化为两个倾向性分类任务。在合成数据和随机化真实世界数据的基准测试中，Q-Learner被证明特别适合工业实践。仅需对其log-loss进行标准的超参数调优，就足以使其在排序上表现良好，并比其他方法更可靠地把握效应的水平和分布；相比之下，例如常见的S-Learner需要昂贵的、针对效应的专门调优才能在排序上表现良好。
tldr: 本文提出Q-Learner方法，将二元结果的比率CATE估计转化为两个倾向性分类任务，仅需标准的log-loss超参数调优即可可靠地估计处理效应的水平与分布，尤其适合工业实践场景。
en_tdlr: The Q-Learner reduces ratio-based CATE estimation for binary outcomes to two propensity classification tasks, requiring only standard log-loss hyperparameter tuning to reliably capture the level and spread of treatment effects, making it especially suited to industry practice.
